                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गति = 33.33 मीटर/सेकंड

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Length of the platform = 238 meters

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Length of the express train = 162 meters

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Speed of the train = 120 km/h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Time = Distance / Speed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Total distance to be covered by the train = Length of the platform + Length of the train

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Total distance = 238 m + 162 m

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Total distance = 400 meters

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Speed of the train in meters per second:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Speed = 120 km/h = 120 × (1000/3600) m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Speed = 120 × (5/18) m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Speed = 33.33 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Time taken to clear the platform:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Time = Distance / Speed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Time = 400 / 33.33

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Time = 12 seconds

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The correct answer is 12 seconds.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्लेटफॉर्म की लंबाई = 238 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            एक्सप्रेस ट्रेन की लंबाई = 162 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ट्रेन की गति = 120 किमी/घंटा

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            समय = दूरी / गति

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ट्रेन द्वारा तय की जाने वाली कुल दूरी = प्लेटफॉर्म की लंबाई + ट्रेन की लंबाई

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            कुल दूरी = 238 मीटर + 162 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            कुल दूरी = 400 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ट्रेन की गति मीटर प्रति सेकंड में:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गति = 120 किमी/घंटा = 120 ×ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ప్లాట్‌ఫాం పొడవు = 238 మీటర్లు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్ రైలు పొడవు = 162 మీటర్లు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            రైలు వేగం = 120 కి.మీ/గంట

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            సమయం = దూరం / వేగం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            రైలు దాటాల్సిన మొత్తం దూరం = ప్లాట్‌ఫాం పొడవు + రైలు పొడవు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            మొత్తం దూరం = 238 మీ + 162 మీ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            మొత్తం దూరం = 400 మీటర్లు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            రైలు వేగం (మీటర్లు/సెకను):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            వేగం = 120 కి.మీ/గంట = 120 x (1000/3600) మీ/సె

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            వేగం = 120 x (5/18) మీ/సె

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            వేగం = 33.33 మీ/సె

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ప్లాట్‌ఫాంను దాటడానికి పట్టే సమయం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            సమయం = దూరం / వేగం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            సమయం = 400 / 33.33

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            సమయం = 12 సెకన్లు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            సరైన సమాధానం 12 సెకన్లు.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "mr": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्लॅटफॉर्मची लांबी = 238 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            एक्स्प्रेस ट्रेनची लांबी = 162 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ट्रेनचा वेग = 120 किमी/तास

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वेळ = अंतर / वेग

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ट्रेनने कापायचे एकूण अंतर = प्लॅटफॉर्मची लांबी + ट्रेनची लांबी

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            एकूण अंतर = 238 मीटर + 162 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            एकूण अंतर = 400 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ट्रेनचा वेग मीटर प्रति सेकंद (m/s) मध्ये:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वेग = 120 किमी/तास = 120 × (1000/3600) मी/से

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वेग = 120 × (5/18) मी/से

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वेग = 33.33 मी/से

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्लॅटफॉर्म पार करण्यासाठी लागणारा वेळ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वेळ = अंतर / वेग

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वेळ = 400 / 33.33

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वेळ = 12 सेकंद

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            योग्य उत्तर 12 सेकंद आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "bn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            প্ল্যাটফর্মের দৈর্ঘ্য = 238 মিটার

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            এক্সপ্রেস ট্রেনের দৈর্ঘ্য = 162 মিটার

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ট্রেনের গতি = 120 কিমি/ঘন্টা

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            সময় = দূরত্ব / গতি

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ট্রেন দ্বারা অতিক্রান্ত মোট দূরত্ব = প্ল্যাটফর্মের দৈর্ঘ্য + ট্রেনের দৈর্ঘ্য

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            মোট দূরত্ব = 238 মিটার + 162 মিটার

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

{"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The correct answer is 1907.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO) was incorporated in 1907 by Jamsetji Tata.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • TISCO was established in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, and is one of the largest steel-producing companies in India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • It was the first privately owned steel company in India and laid the foundation for India’s modern industrial development.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • In 2005, TISCO was renamed as Tata Steel Limited to reflect its global expansion and modernization.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Tata Steel is known for its innovations in the steel industry, focusing on sustainability, advanced technology, and social responsibility.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Jamsetji Tata:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Jamsetji Tata, often called the "Father of Indian Industry," was the visionary behind the establishment of TISCO, which aimed to make India self-reliant in steel production.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Jamshedpur:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The city of Jamshedpur was named after Jamsetji Tata and is often referred to as the "Steel City" of India due to its significant industrial base centered around Tata Steel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Indian Steel Industry:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • India is now the second-largest steel producer in the world, and Tata Steel plays a pivotal role in the country's steel industry, both domestically and globally.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Tata Group:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Tata Steel is part of the Tata Group, one of India's largest and most respected business conglomerates, with interests in various sectors like automobiles, telecommunications, and hospitality.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            सही उत्तर 1907 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • टाटा आयरन एंड स्टील कंपनी (TISCO) का निगमन 1907 में जमशेदजी टाटा द्वारा किया गया था।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
