                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  బారువడ్డీ (SI) = ₹31,500 - ₹25,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  SI = ₹6,500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ₹6,500 = ₹25,000 x R x 4 / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ₹6,500 = ₹1,00,000 x R / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ₹6,500 = ₹1,000 x R

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ R = ₹6,500 / ₹1,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ R = 6.5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  వడ్డీ శాతం 6.5%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n", "mr": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  मुद्दल (P) = ₹25,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  रास (A) = ₹31,500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  काळ (T) = 4 वर्षे

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  सरळ व्याज (SI) = A - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  SI = P × R × T / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  सरळ व्याज (SI) = ₹31,500 - ₹25,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  SI = ₹6,500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ₹6,500 = ₹25,000 × R × 4 / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ₹6,500 = ₹1,00,000 × R / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ₹6,500 = ₹1,000 × R

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ R = ₹6,500 / ₹1,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ R = 6.5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  व्याजाचा दर 6.5% आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n", "bn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  মূলধন (P) = 25,000 টাকা 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  মোট অঙ্ক (A) = 31,500 টাকা

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  সময় (T) = 4 বছর

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  সরল সুদ (SI) = A - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  SI = P x R x T / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  সরল সুদ (SI) = 31,500 টাকা  - 25,000 টাকা 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  SI = 6,500 টাকা 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  6,500 টাকা  = 25,000 টাকা x R x 4 / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  6,500 টাকা  = 1,00,000 টাকা  x R / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  6,500 টাকা  = 1,000 টাকা  x R

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ R = 6,500 টাকা / 1,000 টাকা 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ R = 6.5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  সুদের হার 6.5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n", "ml": "", "gu": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  આપેલ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  રકમ (A) = રૂ.31,500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  સાદું વ્યાજ (SI) = A - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  SI = P x R x T / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  સાદું વ્યાજ (SI) = રૂ.31,500 - રૂ.25,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  SI = રૂ.6,500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  રૂ.6,500 = રૂ.25,000 x R x 4 / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  રૂ.6,500 = રૂ.1,00,000 x R / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  રૂ.6,500 = રૂ.1,000 x R

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ R = રૂ.6,500 / રૂ.1,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ R = 6.5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  વ્યાજનો દર 6.5% છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n", "kn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಮೊತ್ತ (A) = ₹31,500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  SI = ₹6,500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ₹6,500 = ₹25,000 x R x 4 / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ R = 6.5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The correct answer is Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • NPK refers to the three essential nutrients required for plant growth: Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), and Potassium (K).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Nitrogen is crucial for the growth of leaves and stems, promoting lush, green foliage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Phosphorus is important for root development, flower formation, and overall plant energy transfer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Potassium helps in the overall functioning of plant cells, including water regulation and disease resistance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Fertilizer labels often display NPK ratios, indicating the percentage of each nutrient, which helps in determining the appropriate application for specific crops.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Fertilizers are labeled with an NPK ratio, represented by three numbers, which specify the percentage of each nutrient in the fertilizer. For example, a ratio of 16-20-18 means the fertilizer contains 16% nitrogen, 20% phosphorus, and 18% potassium .
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
