                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • தாவரங்களுக்குள் ஆற்றல் பரிமாற்றத்தில் பாஸ்பரஸ் முக்கிய பங்கு வகிக்கிறது, முதன்மையாக ATP (அடினோசின் ட்ரைபாஸ்பேட்) மூலம், இது வளர்சிதை மாற்ற செயல்முறைகளுக்கு அவசியமானது.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • பொட்டாசியம் (K) :\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • தாவரங்களில் நொதி செயல்படுத்தல் மற்றும் ஒளிச்சேர்க்கை போன்ற பல்வேறு உடலியல் செயல்முறைகளை ஒழுங்குபடுத்துவதில் பொட்டாசியம் ஈடுபட்டுள்ளது.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • NPK உரங்களின் முக்கியத்துவம் :\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • பயிர்களில் சமச்சீர் ஊட்டச்சத்துக்கு NPK உரங்கள் மிக முக்கியமானவை, மேலும் அவற்றின் சரியான பயன்பாடு மகசூல் மற்றும் தரத்தை கணிசமாக மேம்படுத்தும்.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • பயன்பாடு மற்றும் விகிதங்கள் :\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • வெவ்வேறு தாவரங்களுக்கு வெவ்வேறு ஊட்டச்சத்து தேவைகள் உள்ளன, எனவே NPK உரத்தின் தேர்வு மண்ணின் ஊட்டச்சத்து அளவுகள், தாவர வகை மற்றும் வளர்ச்சி நிலை ஆகியவற்றைப் பொறுத்தது.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n1e3:Te0c,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The correct answer is Virat Kohli.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In 2018, Indian cricketer Virat Kohli received the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The award is India's highest sporting honor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The award includes a medal, certificate, and a cash prize of ₹25 lakh.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Other recipient in 2018: Mirabai Chanu for Weightlifting.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award (RGKR) is India's highest sporting honor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Established: In 1991–92, named after Rajiv Gandhi, India's 6th Prime Minister.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Renamed in 2021: Now called the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award, after the legendary Indian field hockey player.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • First recipient: Chess Grandmaster Viswanathan Anand.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Youngest recipient: Abhinav Bindra at age 18.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2023 was awarded to Chirag Chandrashekhar Shetty and Satwiksairaj Rankireddy, both in the discipline of Badminton. 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Athletes are evaluated based on their performances over the preceding four years in major international competitions.The correct answer is Virat Kohli.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In 2018, Indian cricketer Virat Kohli received the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The award is India's highest sporting honor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The award includes a medal, certificate, and a cash prize of ₹25 lakh.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Other recipient in 2018: Mirabai Chanu for Weightlifting.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award (RGKR) is India's highest sporting honor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Established: In 1991–92, named after Rajiv Gandhi, India's 6th Prime Minister.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Renamed in 2021: Now called the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award, after the legendary Indian field hockey player.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • First recipient: Chess Grandmaster Viswanathan Anand.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Youngest recipient: Abhinav Bindra at age 18.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2023 was awarded to Chirag Chandrashekhar Shetty and Satwiksairaj Rankireddy, both in the discipline of Badminton. 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Athletes are evaluated based on their performances over the preceding four years in major international competitions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The award recognizes athletes for their outstanding performances at the international level, including events like the Olympics, World Championships, and other prestigious international tournaments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Nominations for the award are made by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, based on recommendations from the selection committee.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  सही उत्तर विराट कोहली है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • 2018 में, भारतीय क्रिकेटर विराट कोहली को राजीव गांधी खेल रत्न पुरस्कार मिला।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • यह पुरस्कार भारत का सर्वोच्च खेल सम्मान है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • इस पुरस्कार में पदक, प्रमाण पत्र, और ₹25 लाख का नकद पुरस्कार शामिल है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • 2018 में अन्य प्राप्तकर्ता: मीराबाई चानू (भारोत्तोलन)।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  సరైన సమాధానం విరాట్ కోహ్లీ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • 2018లో, భారతీయ క్రికెటర్ విరాట్ కోహ్లీ రాజీవ్ గాంధీ క్రీడా రత్న అవార్డును అందుకున్నాడు.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ఈ అవార్డు భారతదేశంలోని అత్యున్నత క్రీడా గౌరవం.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ఈ అవార్డులో పతకం, ధృవపత్రం, మరియు ₹25 లక్షల నగదు బహుమతి ఉంటాయి.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • 2018లో మరో గ్రహీత: వెయిట్‌లిఫ్టింగ్‌లో మీరాబాయి చాను.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Additional Information 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • రాజీవ్ గాంధీ క్రీడా రత్న అవార్డు (RGKR) భారతదేశంలోని అత్యున్నత క్రీడా గౌరవం.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • స్థాపించబడింది: 1991-92లో, భారతదేశ 6వ ప్రధానమంత్రి రాజీవ్ గాంధీ పేరు మీద.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • 2021లో పేరు మార్చబడింది: ప్రస్తుతం దీనిని పురాణ భారతీయ హాకీ ఆటగాడు మేజర్ ధ్యాన్ చంద్ క్రీడా రత్న అవార్డు అని పిలుస్తారు.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • మొదటి గ్రహీత: చెస్ గ్రాండ్ మాస్టర్ విశ్వనాథన్ ఆనంద్.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • అతి చిన్న వయసు గ్రహీత: 18 ఏళ్ల వయసులో అభినవ్ బింద్రా.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • 2023లో మేజర్ ధ్యాన్ చంద్ క్రీడా రత్న అవార్డును చిరాగ్ చంద్రశేఖర్ శెట్టి మరియు సాత్విక్‌సాయిరాజ్ ర్యాంక్రెడ్డి (ఇద్దరూ బ్యాడ్మింటన్‌లో) అందుకున్నారు.
