                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\sqrt{484\\sqrt{25 ÷ x}} = 22\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(484\\sqrt{25 ÷ x} = 22^2\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(484\\sqrt{25 ÷ x}\\) = 484

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\sqrt{25 ÷ x}\\) = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Square both sides again:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 25 ÷ x = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 25 = x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is option 4 (25).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n1ec:T5e1,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ವರ್ಗಮೂಲವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಲು ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿಗಳನ್ನು ವರ್ಗಗೊಳಿಸಿ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\sqrt{484\\sqrt{25 ÷ x}} = 22\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(484\\sqrt{25 ÷ x} = 22^2\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(484\\sqrt{25 ÷ x}\\) = 484

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\sqrt{25 ÷ x}\\) = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ಮತ್ತೆ ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿಗಳನ್ನು ವರ್ಗಗೊಳಿಸಿ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 25 ÷ x = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 25 = x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ ಆಯ್ಕೆ 4 (25).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "ta": "

"625 "}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\frac{1}{25}∶ \\frac{1}{x} = \\frac{1}{x}∶\\frac{1}{625}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    In a proportion \\(\\frac{a}{b} = \\frac{c}{d}\\) , then a × d = b × c

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Given: \\(\\frac{1}{25}∶ \\frac{1}{x} = \\frac{1}{x}∶\\frac{1}{625}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Convert the proportion to an equation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\frac{1}{25} × \\frac{1}{625} = \\frac{1}{x} × \\frac{1}{x}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\frac{1}{25 × 625} = \\frac{1}{x^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\frac{1}{25^2 × 25} = \\frac{1}{x^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\frac{1}{25^3} = \\frac{1}{x^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(x^2 = 25^3\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = \\(\\sqrt{25^3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 251.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 25 ×  5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 125

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The value of x is 125.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n1ee:T6b5,\n", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\frac{1}{25}∶ \\frac{1}{x} = \\frac{1}{x}∶\\frac{1}{625}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    एक समानुपात \\(\\frac{a}{b} = \\frac{c}{d}\\) में, a x d = b x c

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है: \\(\\frac{1}{25}∶ \\frac{1}{x} = \\frac{1}{x}∶\\frac{1}{625}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    समानुपात को समीकरण में बदलें:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\frac{1}{25} × \\frac{1}{625} = \\frac{1}{x} × \\frac{1}{x}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\frac{1}{25 × 625} = \\frac{1}{x^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\frac{1}{25^2 × 25} = \\frac{1}{x^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\frac{1}{25^3} = \\frac{1}{x^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(x^2 = 25^3\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = \\(\\sqrt{25^3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 251.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 25 x 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n1ef:T4df,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\frac{1}{25}∶ \\frac{1}{x} = \\frac{1}{x}∶\\frac{1}{625}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\frac{1}{25}∶ \\frac{1}{x} = \\frac{1}{x}∶\\frac{1}{625}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఇవ్వబడింది: \\(\\frac{1}{25}∶ \\frac{1}{x} = \\frac{1}{x}∶\\frac{1}{625}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    నిష్పత్తిని సమీకరణంగా మార్చండి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\frac{1}{25} × \\frac{1}{625} = \\frac{1}{x} × \\frac{1}{x}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रमाण", "mr": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\frac{1}{25}∶ \\frac{1}{x} = \\frac{1}{x}∶\\frac{1}{625}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Ramu, Rohit, and Shyam together can finish a piece of work in 8 days.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Ramu alone can complete this work in 16 days.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Rohit alone can complete this work in 24 days.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
